introduction.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Techno Volution (“we”, “us”, or “our”) operates Mero Chef, an application for Android and iOS that keeps track of the food you have at home, warns you before it expires, and uses artificial intelligence to suggest recipes. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information when you use the Mero Chef app and this website.

This policy describes our data practices; reading it or using Mero Chef does not by itself constitute consent to optional processing. You can use your pantry, minimum-stock alerts, expiry reminders, and saved recipes without an account, and that information stays on your phone. Features that use artificial intelligence need an account. Advertising, when it is present, may process data even if you have not signed in.

informationCollection.title: Information Collection and Use
paragraphs: Mero Chef keeps your pantry on your phone. What else we process depends on the features you choose to use.

subsections.title: Local use (no account)
paragraphs: The following is stored only on your device, in a local database and in the app’s private storage: the ingredients you add (name, quantity, unit, category, storage place, expiration date, and emoji); a log of when you mark something as used or remove it, which is used to calculate your waste figure; the minimum amounts you set for restock alerts; the recipes you save and which steps you have ticked; the foods the app has suggested to you before, remembered by language and country so they appear instantly next time; and your diet preferences.

None of this is uploaded unless you use an online feature described below. On Android, Mero Chef turns off cloud backup and device-to-device transfer for the app, so this information is not copied elsewhere automatically. On iOS, operating-system backups, such as iCloud or a computer backup, may include the app’s data depending on your device settings. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage removes the data from your device.

subsections.title: Optional Google account
paragraphs: To use the AI features you sign in with Google (or, on iOS, with Apple, as described below). From Google Sign-In we receive your Google account identifier, email address, and display name, and we store them to create and manage your Mero Chef account. We do not receive your Google password or other Google data such as your contacts. Google processes this information under its own privacy policy.

When you sign in, your phone also sends a random installation identifier, generated by the app and not tied to your advertising ID or hardware identifiers, so that your sessions on different phones can be told apart. Your session tokens are kept on your device in secure storage: the Android Keystore on Android and the Keychain on iOS.

subsections.title: Optional Sign in with Apple
paragraphs: On iOS, Sign in with Apple provides an Apple account identifier and, when supplied, your name and email address. If you choose Hide My Email, this may be an Apple private relay address. We use these details and authentication tokens to create your Mero Chef account and manage your session. We do not receive your Apple password.

subsections.title: AI features
paragraphs: When you use an AI feature, the app sends the information that feature needs to our API, which passes it to an AI provider and returns the result. Depending on the feature, this can include:
list: Recipes: the ingredients you chose from your pantry (name, quantity, unit, category, and expiration date), the dish you typed if you asked for a specific dish, your diet choices, the language of the app, and your country code.

Photos: a photo of a receipt or package that you take with the camera or choose from your gallery or photo library. It is resized and compressed on your phone and sent to be read. A receipt may show other personal details, such as a store, card digits, or loyalty numbers, so photograph only the part you need.
Kitchen video: a video of up to 20 seconds that you record or choose. The app takes a few still frames from it on your phone and sends only those frames, never the video.

Voice: when you dictate ingredients, your phone’s speech recognition service turns your speech into text, and the app sends that text (up to 1,500 characters) to be turned into a list of items. Mero Chef does not record or store audio and never receives it.

Name suggestions: while you type an ingredient name and after a short pause, the text you typed, the app language, and your country code are sent to complete the name. This happens only when you are signed in; otherwise the foods already remembered on your phone are used.

subsections.title: How AI requests are handled
paragraphs: Our API sends these requests to OpenRouter, which routes them to a model provider (for example, one of Google’s Gemini models). We ask OpenRouter to use only providers that do not collect data for training and that support zero data retention for AI inputs and outputs. These routing controls apply to model processing; they do not mean that technical metadata, our diagnostic logs, or temporary processing context are never retained. OpenRouter and the model providers have their own data practices.

We do not store your photos, frames, dictated text, or typed prompts, and our logs record only counts and sizes (such as how many ingredients, the size of an image, or how many tokens were used), never the content. We do not include your name or email address in these requests. Only use content you are entitled to share, and avoid photographing documents with unnecessary personal information.

subsections.title: Subscriptions and purchase verification
paragraphs: Google Play on Android and the Apple App Store on iOS process payment for the optional monthly subscriptions (Chef Junior and Chef Master). To verify purchases and give you access, the app sends the store’s purchase information to our backend (a Google Play purchase token and product identifier, or signed Apple App Store transaction data), which asks the store to confirm the subscription. A pseudonymous identifier derived from your account is attached to the purchase so that it cannot be used on another account. We also receive notifications from the stores about those subscriptions, such as renewals, cancellations, and refunds.
Mero Chef does not receive your payment card details. Manage renewal and cancellation in Google Play, or in your Apple Account settings if you subscribed on iOS.

subsections.title: What we store about your account
paragraphs: On our servers, we keep only what is needed to run your account:
list: Account: your Google or Apple account identifier, email address (which may be an Apple private relay address), display name, and the date the account was created.

Sessions: a one-way hash of each sign-in token (never the token itself), linked to your account and to the installation identifier, with its expiry date, plus the records needed to end a session immediately when you sign out.
Subscriptions: the store’s purchase token or transaction identifiers, product, plan, status, expiry date, and renewal setting.
Usage: how many units of your plan’s monthly AI allowance you have used in the current month.

subsections.title: Shared Master
paragraphs: A Chef Master owner can invite one person using their email and a code valid for 48 hours. We store both account identifiers, the invitation email, its expiry and a hash of the code; we do not store the original code. The recipient signs in with the invited email to accept. Each person keeps an independent monthly AI allowance.

The owner and recipient can see each other’s email and display name. Sharing Master does not share the pantry, saved recipes or preferences. You can send the code through your device’s share feature; the service you choose handles that message under its own practices.

The owner can cancel an invitation or remove the recipient, and either person can end the relationship in the app. Deleting an account also deletes its sharing relationship. When Master expires, shared access pauses but the relationship stays for renewal; joining or leaving does not reset monthly usage.

permissions.title: Device permissions and controls
paragraphs: Permissions are used only for the features you choose. You can refuse or revoke them in your device settings; the related feature may then be unavailable.

subsections.title: Microphone and speech recognition
paragraphs: Dictating ingredients uses the microphone only while you are recording, and relies on your phone’s speech recognition service to produce text. On iOS, the app asks for microphone and speech recognition permission first. Depending on the device, language, and service, audio may be processed remotely by Apple, Google, or the speech provider configured on your phone; on-device processing is not guaranteed. Mero Chef receives and sends only the resulting text, not audio. Stopping or canceling the recording ends microphone capture.

subsections.title: Camera, photos, and video
paragraphs: On Android, Mero Chef does not ask for the camera permission: photos and videos are taken by your phone’s camera app, or you pick them with Android’s picker. On iOS, the app asks for camera access when you take a photo or video in the app, and uses the system photo picker for what you select. In both cases the app receives only the file you choose; picking one item is not permission to access your whole photo library. A photo or the frames of a video are sent to our API and AI providers as described above.

subsections.title: Notifications
paragraphs: Expiry alerts, low-stock alerts, and kitchen timers are created on your phone; on iOS the app asks your permission before showing notifications. We do not send push notifications from a server, and you can turn notifications off in your device settings.

subsections.title: Country and language
paragraphs: The default region comes from language, system settings, or the SIM or network country, depending on the information available on your device. On Android and iOS, when the feature is available in your version, you can optionally enable “Use precise location for recipes” and grant permission while using the app. When requesting a recipe, the app uses location and the device geocoding service to determine the country and city, when available. The app does not save coordinates or addresses; only country and city are sent to our API and AI providers to tailor the recipe. If you disable the option, revoke permission, or location is unavailable, the default region is used. Background location is not requested.

subsections.title: Advertising identifier
paragraphs: When advertising is present, Google AdMob uses your device’s advertising identifier subject to your device settings and applicable consent, as described in the Advertising section. On iOS, the identifier is available for tracking only if you allow it when the app asks (App Tracking Transparency). This is separate from the microphone, camera, and notification features.

subsections.title: What Mero Chef does not access
paragraphs: Mero Chef does not request access to your contacts, calendar, call or text message data, or files. We do not integrate analytics or crash-reporting SDKs to track your behavior inside the app.

logData.title: Log Data
paragraphs: When you use sign-in, subscription, or AI features, our API servers may automatically collect technical log data such as your IP address, request timestamps and paths, response status and time, a request identifier, and error diagnostics. We use this information to maintain, secure, and improve our services, and your IP address is also used to limit abusive request rates. Request contents, such as your pantry, photos, and text, and sign-in tokens are not written to our logs.
Other than the advertising described below, Mero Chef does not integrate Firebase Analytics or similar third-party in-app analytics SDKs to track your behavior inside the app.

cookies.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This website stores your selected language in browser localStorage. This preference is not used for advertising or behavioral tracking. The page does not set tracking cookies or web beacons.

The Mero Chef Android and iOS applications do not use web cookies. Your sign-in tokens and preferences are stored on your device using secure storage mechanisms of the operating system, such as the Android Keystore and the iOS Keychain.

advertising.title: Advertising
paragraphs: The Mero Chef Android and iOS apps show, or may begin to show in an upcoming version, banner ads served by Google AdMob. This section applies from the version of the app that includes advertising. AdMob and its advertising partners may collect device identifiers (such as your device’s advertising identifier), IP address, approximate location, and app usage data to serve, measure, and — where you consent — personalize ads. We do not send your pantry, recipes, photos, or account details to AdMob.

On iOS, the app requests App Tracking Transparency (ATT) permission before accessing the advertising identifier for tracking. If you refuse, that identifier is unavailable for tracking; ads may still appear and AdMob may process technical data for their delivery. On Android, advertising identifiers are subject to your device settings and applicable advertising consent; you can reset or delete your advertising ID, and opt out of ads personalization, in your device’s Google settings. You can review or restrict these permissions in device settings.

On Android, the app integrates Google’s User Messaging Platform (UMP) to ask for advertising consent where it is required, such as in the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland, and to let you change your choice later. On iOS, the app requests App Tracking Transparency (ATT) permission; ATT is separate from the consent required for advertising in the EEA, the UK, or Switzerland, which is handled separately where required. You can change platform permissions in device settings and contact {{email}} about advertising privacy choices.

serviceProviders.title: Service Providers
paragraphs: Third parties process information for authentication, subscription verification, speech recognition, advertising, AI, infrastructure, and database services, as described in this policy. Their purposes and data practices differ; review the relevant policies below.
Each provider operates under its own privacy policy. We encourage you to review those policies using the links below.
list: Google — Google Sign-In, and Google Play Billing and the Google Play Developer API for optional subscriptions
Apple — Sign in with Apple, App Store subscriptions, and speech recognition on iOS
Google AdMob — advertising in the Mero Chef Android and iOS apps, when advertising is present
OpenRouter and the model providers serving requests — text and image processing for AI features
Microsoft Azure — hosting of the Mero Chef API
MongoDB — database service for account, subscription, and usage records
Redis — in-memory store for sign-in sessions, hosted with our cloud provider
Google or the configured speech recognition service — voice transcription on Android

internationalTransfers.title: International processing
paragraphs: Our hosting, database, authentication, advertising, speech recognition, and AI providers may process data in countries other than yours. The location depends on the provider and service configuration. International transfers and processing are subject to applicable law and any required safeguards. Contact {{email}} for information about the recipients, locations, and safeguards relevant to your data; this policy does not assert that all data stays in one country.

retention.title: Data retention
paragraphs: Local data remains on your device until you remove it, uninstall the app, or clear the app’s storage. Files and copies you make yourself are separate and under your control.

Your account, subscription, and usage records are kept to provide your account, your plan, and its monthly allowance until you delete your account or the data is otherwise removed. Sessions end when they expire or when you sign out. Retention of technical logs, purchase-related records, and backups, where maintained, depends on their operational purpose, security needs, and applicable legal obligations. Retention by AI providers is described in the AI section; no single deletion period applies to every category.

For the retention applicable to a specific record, or a request covering logs or backups, contact {{email}}. We do not promise that deleting an account instantly removes every copy from every service or device.

privacyRights.title: Your rights and privacy requests
paragraphs: Techno Volution operates Mero Chef and is the contact responsible for its data practices. Send privacy questions, requests, and complaints to {{email}}. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, a copy of your data, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or objection to processing, and withdraw consent where processing relies on consent.

Describe your request and identify the affected account. We may ask for information reasonably necessary to verify your identity; do not send passwords, full payment card details, or unnecessary sensitive documents. Requests are handled within the periods required by applicable law, with any permitted exceptions explained. You may also complain to the relevant data protection authority, including Colombia’s SIC where applicable.

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, your account and the online services you request rely on providing those services; security and service maintenance may rely on legitimate interests where permitted; optional processing that requires consent, such as advertising personalization, relies on that consent; and legally required recordkeeping relies on legal obligations. Withdrawal of consent does not invalidate earlier lawful processing, and may prevent the related optional feature from working.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable measures to protect your information, including HTTPS encryption in transit, short-lived access tokens and single-use refresh tokens for API access, storage of only a one-way hash of each refresh token on our servers, immediate revocation of sessions when you sign out or delete your account, and sealing of your sign-in tokens on your phone with the Android Keystore or the iOS Keychain.
No method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

linksToOtherSites.title: Links to Other Sites
paragraphs: Mero Chef and this website may contain links to third-party websites or services, including privacy policies of our service providers. We do not control and are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.
We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of every third-party site you visit.

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Mero Chef is not directed at children under 13. Where local law sets a higher age for independent consent, that requirement also applies. Contact {{email}} if you believe a child’s data has been provided improperly.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the effective date at the bottom of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any changes. If we add features that process your data in new ways, such as syncing your pantry to the cloud, we will update this policy before they become available.

Updates to this policy do not by themselves authorize new optional processing. Where required, we will seek a new authorization or consent for changes to purposes or sharing. The effective date identifies the version of this policy.

accountDeletion.title: Account Deletion
paragraphs: If you created a Mero Chef account by signing in with Google or Sign in with Apple, you can delete it in the app. This does not delete your Google or Apple account. The scope and limitations are described below.

subsections.title: What is deleted
paragraphs: The in-app process removes your Mero Chef account profile (Google or Apple account identifier, email address, and display name), all sign-in sessions on every device, your subscription records, and your usage records. Technical logs and backups, where maintained, are not all covered by this automatic process; contact {{email}} for a request that includes those records.

subsections.title: Local data on your device
paragraphs: After deletion the app signs you out, but your pantry, saved recipes, and settings stay on your phone, since they never left it. To remove them, uninstall the app or clear its storage in your device settings.

subsections.title: How to delete your account in the app
paragraphs: Follow these steps on your Android or iOS device:
list: Open Mero Chef on your Android or iOS device and make sure you are connected to the internet.

Tap the person icon in the top bar to open your account. If you are asked to sign in, use the same method you used to create the account: Google, or Sign in with Apple on iOS. On Android, select the correct Google profile if you have more than one.
Tap Delete account.
Read the confirmation explaining that account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.
Tap Delete to confirm. Choose Cancel if you do not want to proceed; canceling does not remove any data.
Wait for deletion to finish. If an error appears, check your connection, sign in again if needed, and retry.

subsections.title: Local-only use (without an account)
paragraphs: If you never signed in, we hold no account data about you. Your pantry and recipes are only on your phone, and uninstalling the app removes them. Advertising and speech recognition, when used, may process data even without an account.

subsections.title: Timing
paragraphs: The active records covered by in-app deletion are removed when the server successfully completes the request. This does not imply immediate erasure of logs, backups, or data held by third-party services. Contact {{email}} for the scope and timing of a broader deletion request.

subsections.title: Need help?
paragraphs: If you cannot access the app, contact us at {{email}} from the email address of your Google account and we will assist with account deletion requests.

subsections.title: Store subscriptions and Apple authorization
paragraphs: Deleting your Mero Chef account does not automatically cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription; cancel it separately through the store. Removing a Mero Chef session is also distinct from revoking Sign in with Apple authorization; you can manage that authorization in your Apple Account settings. Contact {{email}} if you need help with either process.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at {{email}}.
